title: A Multi-Agent Voice-Based AI System for Hybrid Learning Using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (Capstone Report)
description:
Capstone project report (Post Graduate Program in Generative AI & Machine Learning, April 2026) presenting the architecture and design of a voice-based multi-agent AI system for hybrid learning. The proposed system combines document-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) using FAISS with open-domain topic knowledge, coordinated by specialized agents for routing, retrieval, summarization and voice interaction.

This record contains the capstone report and architecture diagram. Implementation code is not included.
